depth_findings.text: answerPendingQuestion and skipPendingQuestion write after their await with no thread check. If the person opens another thread while the request is in flight, the settle clears that thread's restored card, and answerPendingQuestion's sendContent can post the summary into the newly opened thread. Suggested guard: read state.threadId before the request, and after it return when the thread has changed, before setPendingQuestion(null) and sendContent. Not implemented, because it is outside the required fix.
The answer route records the answer before the turn is appended, so if the turn append fails the question stays answered with no turn carrying it.
answered_message_id is never set: the link needs the appended turn's id, which session_flow.rs does not return to the invoke stream and which is not owned here.

results.notes: Built: the Customize hub (CustomizeHub.tsx) composes the agent-mode and hook sections with the existing MCP, skills, org-instructions and plugin sections, and sits behind a cached probe of GET /api/v1/org/agent-policy (404 means ORG_AGENT_POLICY_API is off, and the hub then says it is not switched on). AgentModesSection edits the org cap, rung cap, lockdown, the MCP allow-list and the tool approval, saves the whole document at the revision it read, shows members a read-only view with a locked badge, and has an explain panel of effective values. HooksSection lists rules, lets an admin add, edit or retire them, and has a test-match panel that applies deny over ask over allow; a post-tool rule may only deny. ChatbotStudioCards replaces the disabled Customize placeholder with a link to /agents/customize once the API is on. DashboardComposer adds a mode picker beside the Ask/Do controls, limited to the cap and the modes stricter than it. It sends agentMode only when the person picks one, drops a choice the cap no longer admits, and is not offered in conversation-only turns. No switch was added (the row has none); the hub is gated by the policy API. Status is partial because the code and unit tests are complete, but the route, nav entry and chat wiring are shared files that the lead must apply, and the e2e and live proof have not been run. The chat-client.ts, ComposerTrays.tsx and QuestionCard files in the worktree belong to the concurrent WS14-S4 slice; I did not touch them.
